mobile_ui_status: Passed. Both Settings entry points, native options menus, launch behavior, and final accessibility layout verified on iPhone and iPad simulators.
limitations: Mobile validation uses simulators; physical-device and third-party cloud-provider restoration are not verified.
release_build_notes: All final Release builds succeeded and strict code-signature verification passed. No Swift compiler warnings; Xcode emits the standard skipped AppIntents metadata extraction notice because the app does not use AppIntents.
verification_notes: The result bundles include focused reruns; their counts must not be summed as distinct test cases.
UI tests use fictional owned fixtures and isolated preference suites. Product Screenshots were not changed.
Native document-browser toolbar actions use a target/action button and anchored action sheet because an attached UIMenu was not forwarded by the remote browser toolbar.
Settings uses a multiline native Menu at accessibility text sizes to prevent system Picker label clipping.
